title: Chicken Riverina
description: Chicken breast stuffed with dried apricots and almonds, finished with a cream and apricot sauce. Named for the Riverina region of New South Wales.

ingredients.notes: 60g roughly chopped for stuffing, 20g diced for sauce
reserved juice from canned apricots, or soak dried apricots in hot water

method.instruction: Combine 60g roughly chopped dried apricots with slivered almonds to make the stuffing.
Cut a deep pocket in each chicken breast. Fill with apricot and almond stuffing. Secure with toothpicks if needed.
Pan-fry in butter over medium heat until golden and cooked through, approximately 6-8 minutes per side.
Remove chicken and set aside. Add cream and apricot nectar to the pan, scraping up any browned bits.
Simmer until reduced to a light coating consistency, about 2-3 minutes. Stir in remaining 20g diced dried apricots and heat through.
Season with salt and white pepper. Remove toothpicks. Plate chicken and spoon sauce over.

notes.title: Sauce Profile
notes.content: The sauce is cream and apricot nectar forward — let it thicken naturally without flour or demi glace. The stuffing is loose; no binding agent needed, just pack it in firmly.

notes.title: Apricot Nectar
notes.content: If using canned apricots, reserve the syrup. If using dried only, soak 30g extra apricots in 60ml hot water for 30 minutes and use the soaking liquid.
